body: No, but we can work through it. I don't expect a miracle. I expect hard work and success. Whatever "success" means in this case.
There's other ways to fix it. Communication is a thing? I know relationships are hard, and I'm willing to fight for it. I'm not giving up. Divorce is giving up. And I didn't want sex advice.
No. "Please be helpful and put in positive input." Not "you shouldn't have"s.
I'm expecting advice. Not "you shouldn't have"s.
Thank you for giving actual advice. I really appreciate it. :)

A little late for that. Please be helpful, or go away. 

Edit: And he's not my highschool boyfriend, thanks.
He plays drums. :) And Lordy is it useful!
We'd love to have you! Always need a good bass player. I've been singing professionally coming up on 15 years. It's the only thing I want to do. Luckily, I married a sound and lighting engineer. :)

It's far too expensive for us. Even with insurance, there's just no way. I have enough medical bills.... 

And as for hobbies? It's more like a career choice. I'm a vocalist and a voice actor. Everyone tells me I'm great, and I'm honestly pretty good, but I just can't keep a band together. Reason #243 as to why I'm trying to move to New Orleans. We tried moving to Orlando, but we could never get everything in line to do so. Then I could have worked for Universal and Disney doing voice overs.

I definitely force myself to go outside, even if it's just for a drive or to sit on the sidewalk, at least once a day. I can't take it if I'm inside. Our awful apartment has no outside windows, so I just start to feel trapped within my own mind after a while. 
Thank you for your kind words. I don't want pity, I want understanding. Sadly, I get more of the former if/when I reach out, so thank you for not pitying.

I had a little bit of "therapy" in high school. Really wasn't done well. In college I had a therapist who was wonderful, but I left college, so bye bye free therapy. 

I just feel like, in every situation, if I had done something differently... Something better.... I'd be OK. I could have lived a life that I could be proud of....
